messages:
leo: Heads up — after rolling nvidia-driver 541.22 to the eu-west H100 pool, a subset of prod inference containers started failing with NVRTC/PTX errors coming from FlashAttention/xFormers/TensorRT kernels. Canary reproduces.

maya: Do you have logs?

leo: Pasting the most common error fragment we see: 
```
E torch: NVRTC JIT compilation failed: NVRTC_ERROR_COMPILATION
RuntimeError: invalid kernel image for SM_90: PTX version incompatible
File "/opt/conda/lib/python3.9/site-packages/flash_attn/_ext.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so", line 0
```
Also seeing: `trtexec: ERROR: could not find kernel for op FlashAttention` in some TRT jobs.

zach: Quick question: was this driver-only or a CUDA runtime bump? Which container image?

leo: Driver-only (541.22). Containers still have CUDA 12.1 runtime. We ship prebuilt xformers/flashattn wheels targeted at sm_90/ptx for H100s. Looks like the new driver enforces stricter PTX->SASS compatibility or rejects some embedded SASS sections.

karen: Can we route those requests to A100 pools or enable a software fallback in the workers? A100 capacity is thin and cross-region routing will be costly.

leo: Fallback exists but it's a slow CPU/CPU+SIMD path and requires enabling an env var in our image. A100s are near full for the day; moving steady traffic to eu-central would rack up egress + spot costs.

deploy-bot: Rollout record: driver-upgrade-eu-west started 1765001200, progress 60%, 18/30 H100 nodes patched. Canary cluster shows elevated 5xxs on 3 services.

sre-oncall: Pause the rollout, attempt rollback on canary nodes first. Maya, can you coordinate? Also need an immediate mitigation that doesn't require full driver rollback across fleet.

maya: Pausing rollout now. I'm launching rollback against the 18 patched canary nodes (cordon -> drain -> driver-reinstall -> reboot). ETA ~25m. I'll also try a hotpatch to set the worker env var that disables GPU flash kernels for the affected deployment at 5% traffic to verify impact. Note: diverting traffic to eu-central A100 autoscale will increase infra spend ~+12% for the day.

zach: Longer term: add kernel-compat smoke tests to driver canaries: (1) nvrtc compile + load of flashattn/xformers extension, (2) trtexec sample build & run, (3) quick inference with model + KV cache. Also add nvptxinfo or cuobjdump sanity check to detect PTX->SASS incompat issues early.

karen: Immediate mitigation idea: we have an env var in the image `FLASH_ATTENTION_NO_GPU=1` that forces CPU fallback. If it's available in the active image, we can k8s-patch the Deployment to inject that env var on a small percentage of replicas and ramp. Lower perf but reduces errors until rollback completes.

leo: Confirmed `FLASH_ATTENTION_NO_GPU` exists in our `inference-prod:2025-11-17` image. Applying 5% hotpatch now.

maya: 5% patch applied. Error rate dropped from ~8% to ~1.2% for the affected service. Proceeding with canary rollback.

maya: Rollback jobs running — progress report: 10/18 nodes completed, no regressions so far. Estimated full rollback completion 02:30 UTC.

zach: After rollback: schedule a buildbot job to recompile flashattn/xformers wheels against driver 541 and run the new smoke tests before reattempting rollout. Also add a short blurb to the infra release notes about kernel symbol checks and the driver compatibility matrix.

sre-oncall: I'll keep monitoring alerts and update this thread when rollback finishes. Good work coordinating. :white_check_mark:

leo: One more action item — capture a minimal repro (small container + nvrtc compile) and attach to the ticket so vendors (NVIDIA / upstream xformers) can reproduce. I'll drop that artifact in the ticket in ~1h.

maya: noted, linking ticket INFRA-4412.

zach: Thanks everyone — let's treat this as a near-miss and make the smoke tests required for future driver rollouts.
